# truenas_kerberos_keytab (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS Kerberos keytab entry by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Kerberos keytab entry to look up.

### Read-Only

- `file` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded Kerberos keytab data merged into the system keytab.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the Kerberos keytab entry.
